Gold -8.9% on the month: risk appetite is pulling money out of havens.
Copper/gold ratio falling (copper -13.1% vs gold -8.9%): growth worries — favour defensives, trim cyclicals.
Dollar strengthening (+2.5% on the month, +4.3% vs 200-day): headwind for commodities, EM and crypto; AED is pegged so no direct FX effect for you.
Credit risk appetite: Treasuries are beating high-yield this month — risk-off undertone.
Emerging markets lagging the S&P this month (-6.7% vs -5.0%).
UAE equities ETF +12.0% on the month, +11% vs its 200-day — the foreign-investor read on Dubai/Abu Dhabi.
Bitcoin -21.1% on the month, -16% vs 200-day — the liquidity barometer for the crypto sleeve.
Futures positioning: Silver speculators are crowded short (+15% of open interest, 11th percentile of 3 years) — squeeze fuel if price turns up.
